from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

def norm_tokens(s):
    s = s or ''
    s = s.replace(',', ' ')
    s = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]+', ' ', s)
    s = s.strip().lower()
    return [t for t in s.split(' ') if t]

def name_str(p):
    return p.get('name','')+' <'+p.get('email','')+'>'

# load candidate decisions
csv_content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/documents/work/hiringdecisions.csv', access_token=fs_token)['content']
rows=[]
for line in csv_content.strip().splitlines():
    parts=[p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
    if len(parts)!=3: continue
    first,last,decision=parts
    if first.lower()=='candidate_first_name':
        continue
    rows.append({'first':first,'last':last,'decision':decision})
print('candidates',rows)

# using threads variable from previous execution: threads
# threads should exist
print('threads_count',len(threads))

threads_by_candidate={}
for cand in rows:
    fn=cand['first'].lower(); ln=cand['last'].lower()
    matches=[]
    for t in threads:
        tid=t['email_thread_id']
        participants=[p for p in t.get('participants',[]) if p.get('email') and p.get('email')!='eric.bailey@gmail.com']
        for p in participants:
            tokens=norm_tokens(p.get('name'))
            # last match exact token
            last_match = (ln in tokens) or (p.get('email','').lower().find(ln)!=-1)
            if not last_match:
                continue
            first_match = (fn in tokens) or (p.get('email','').lower().find(fn)!=-1)
            matches.append({'thread_id':tid,'participant_name':p.get('name'),'participant_email':p.get('email'),'first_match':first_match,'tokens':tokens,'created_at':t['created_at']})
    threads_by_candidate[f"{cand['first']} {cand['last']}"]=matches

for k,v in threads_by_candidate.items():
    print('\nCandidate',k,'matches_count',len(v))
    # show sorted by created_at desc
    v_sorted=sorted(v,key=lambda x:x['created_at'],reverse=True)
    for item in v_sorted[:10]:
        print(' ',item['thread_id'],item['participant_name'],item['participant_email'],'first_match',item['first_match'],'created_at',item['created_at'])
